issues.description: ArrayHelpers method name mismatch: the template implementation of ArrayHelpers declares a helper method named 'appendElement(T[] array, T element)' but the template's Stock.addToStockIngredients(...) calls ArrayHelpers.addElementToArray(...). The solution repository and intended API use the name 'addElementToArray'. This identifier mismatch will cause a compilation error when building the template (method not found) and will block students from running or testing their work.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the helper method name consistent. Rename the method in the template ArrayHelpers.java from 'appendElement' to 'addElementToArray' (signature: public static <T> T[] addElementToArray(T[] array, T element)) so it matches the call sites in the template Stock.java and the solution. Alternatively, update calls to use 'appendElement', but prefer aligning the template to the solution and problem statement by adopting 'addElementToArray' to avoid confusion.
